rules.sentence: Among individuals who participate in aquatic diving, this condition has been associated with severe, sudden-onset neurological decompression sickness, inner ear decompression sickness, and cutis marmorata.[1][2][3]
Objectives: Identify divers who may have patent foramen ovale by recognizing relevant clinical signs and symptoms during fitness-to-dive evaluations.
Determine the relationship between patent foramen ovale and decompression sickness.
Develop strategies for reducing the risk of decompression sickness in patients with patent foramen ovale who choose to continue diving.
Identify the risks and benefits of PFO closure for divers.
